title: Datacap batch processing stops at document 1 and waits for operator input
description: A batch that should run unattended overnight is stopping after the first document and waiting for operator input. The batch shows the document in the verification screen and is waiting for a human to click 'OK'. The batch was previously running fully automated. A configuration change was made by a junior admin last week.

worklogs.description: Reviewed batch job configuration. Verification action is set to 'Manual' instead of 'Automatic'. For automatic processing, this should be 'Skip verification if confidence above threshold'.
Changed verification setting from Manual to Automatic with 80% confidence threshold. Batch runs unattended again.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I found the configuration change that caused the issue. The batch job has a 'Verification' action that was changed to 'Manual Verification Required' mode. In this mode, every document waits for an operator to review it before continuing - which explains why the batch stops after document 1. Previously it was set to 'Automatic: skip verification for documents above 80% confidence threshold'. I will change it back to the automatic setting. Only documents with low OCR confidence will...

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Please restore the automatic setting. Who can access the batch configuration to prevent this type of change in future?

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Batch configuration restored. The overnight batch will run unattended again. Regarding access control: Datacap has role-based configuration in the Administration Console. Batch job configuration changes should be restricted to 'Datacap Administrator' role only. The junior admin who made the change should have 'Datacap Operator' role, which allows running batches but not changing their configuration. I can update their role if you want to prevent this from happening again.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Yes, please change the junior admin's role to Operator. Configuration changes should be made by senior staff only.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Done. Role changed from Administrator to Operator for the junior admin account. Batch tested - running unattended through all 50 test documents without stopping for verification.

resolutionNote: Batch verification setting was changed from Automatic (skip if confidence >80%) to Manual verification required. A junior admin changed this while exploring the configuration. Restored automatic setting and changed the admin's role to Operator to prevent further unauthorized configuration changes.

csat.comment: Fixed root cause and also tightened access control. Excellent.
